description: DROP PROCEDURE signature requirements and matching, converted 1:1 from ddl/DropProcedureWithParametersTest.java (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE PROCEDURE increment_proc(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN x + 1; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE sum_proc(a INTEGER, b INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN a + b; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE no_args_proc() RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN 100; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE calc_proc(x INTEGER, y INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN 42; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE three_arg_proc(a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN 100; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE string_proc(text VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN text; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE test_proc(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN x * 2; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE mixed_proc(id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, count INTEGER) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN name; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE proc_schema.double_value(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN x * 2; END'
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS missing_proc(INTEGER, VARCHAR)
